risk.label: Risk level
risk.basis: {{cls}}, {{score}} out of 10 on the INFORM risk scale
risk.title: {{cls}} risk: know the risk in this area
risk.live: If you live or work here
risk.plan: If you plan, build, invest or settle here

1.live: The hazards listed below still occur: know them, and keep basic preparedness at home and at work.
1.plan: New settlement, business and investment face few hazard constraints here. Keep to the land-use plan and the building rules so the risk stays low.
1.planHazard: The {{hazard}} hazard is very high ({{score}} out of 10): plan new settlement, business and investment for it: keep to the land-use plan and build to the standards that address it.

2.live: Expect the hazards listed below to disrupt life and livelihoods from time to time: know the safe places and routes, and keep household and business plans ready.
2.plan: Be careful with new settlement and business activities: avoid the exposed zones, build to standard, keep drainage and access routes clear, and insure what can be insured.

3.live: The hazards listed below strike often or hard and the area's capacity to cope is limited: know the safe places and routes and prepare for disruption.
3.plan: Avoid adding more residents or new business activities in the exposed zones. Strict land-use and building standards apply; protective works, moving the most exposed households and stronger local response capacity come first.
